responsibility: Defines the Rust HIR classes for item-level declarations and associated support structures. It models generic parameters, where-clause items, visibility-bearing items, modules, functions, type aliases, structs, enums, unions, traits, impl blocks, extern items, and extern blocks, along with their cloning behavior, visitor entry points, attributes, mappings, and declaration-specific payload such as fields, bounds, signatures, and ABI. This file is the item/declaration half of the HIR tree, distinct from expressions, patterns, statements, and types.
